verdict.rationale: Aider does have a programmatic surface (an unofficial Python scripting API), so asking for a machine-readable spec is a fair question. However, the vendor documents that there is no HTTP API and no machine-readable spec, and probes of the usual OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. The only programmatic interface is explicitly marked as not officially supported or documented, so nothing in the pack delivers a downloadable API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
